newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westpac syndicates A$905 mln facility for APA.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westpac syndicates A$905 mln facility for APA.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Wednesday that it and Natwest Markets, acting as joint arangers, have successfully syndicated a A$905 million debt facility for Australian Pacific Airports Corporation's (APA) successful bid for Melbourne's Tullarmarine airport.
APA, which is led by Britain's BAA Plc with a 25.1 percent stake, won bidding for a 50-year lease on Melbourne airport with an A$1.307 billion bid in May.
The other APA partners are the Australian Mutual Provident Society (AMP) with 49.9 percent and Sydney-based funds manager Axiom with 25 percent.
The syndication was launched within a week of APA being announced as the successful bidder, Westpac said.
Westpac said the syndicate comprised 23 banks with participation levels of A$55 million, A$35 million and A$26 million.
Westpac's head of syndications and agencies, Angela Mentis, said in a statement the transaction was oversubscribed by almost a third.
